about: Every component of the gstack and gbrain donors at their mirror pins (tools/donor-mirrors.json), classified for the plan that absorbs them into westack. Paths are donor paths at the pin; descriptions are westack's own words and no donor text is copied (RIGHTS.md). tools/tests/test_absorption.py checks this file against stack.json, the mirror lock and, when the mirrors are present, the donor trees.
rule: the user, 2026-11-04: absorb everything except paid aspects and redundancies.

classes.include: westack absorbs it: home_skill and slice name where
classes.excluded-paid: needs a paid service (paid_service names it)
classes.excluded-redundant: something already installed or built covers it (covered_by names it)
classes.already-absorbed: an earlier westack wave already took its ideas (covered_by names the skill and record)
classes.donor-internal: exists only to install, upgrade, tune, measure or operate the donor itself; nothing is left to do once the donor is retired
classes.deferred: neither paid nor redundant but cannot be built or tested here yet (trigger names what unblocks it)
classes.needs-decision: neither paid nor redundant, outside the plan's slices; the user decides (question says what)
classes.declined: neither paid nor redundant, and the user chose not to absorb it (decided says who, when and why)
